name: Veggie Ground Chili “Frito Pie” Bowls with Cheese, Tomato & Green Onion

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 red bell pepper
2 stick celery

instructions.primary_message: Trim green onions and cut crosswise into thin pieces. Place half in a small bowl. (Reserve remaining green onions for serving.)
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl with the green onion.
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the veggies.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggie ground and cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ lb veggie ground, plant based

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans; set aside to drain further.
When the veggie ground is done, add vegetables and spices to the pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp chili powder
1 tbsp paprika
1 tsp coriander, ground
1 tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add beans, tomato sauce, and water to the pot; stir to combine the chili, then bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until beans are tender, 12-15 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (8 fl oz) can tomato sauce
1 cup water

instructions.primary_message: While the chili is cooking, small dice tomatoes.
To serve, divide Fritos between bowls; top with chili, cheese, tomatoes, reserved green onions, and hot sauce. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (9.25 oz) bag Fritos corn chips
1 ½ cups shredded cheese, Mexican blend
2 tbsp hot sauce
